title: Vibe Coding Mastery
text:
This is a 21-day journey to becoming a “Vibe Coding” expert. You’ll learn how to leverage Google AI Studio and the Gemini Python SDK to build real applications and AI agents from scratch.



Week 1: Foundations - Master advanced prompting and the Gemini API.
Week 2: Agents - Teach Gemini to use tools and build your Sacristan Assistant.
Week 3: Advanced & Deploy - AI-assisted coding, UIs, and deployment.

Prerequisites: - A basic understanding of logic. - Python installed on your machine. - A Google account to access Google AI Studio.
Get started by navigating to Week 1, Day 1.
